MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Heat shrink tubing feels useful alongside my crimp connectors because it helps insulate the wiring connections I repair.",
    "Epoxy and removable hook-and-loop strips fit my use of tape and vinyl cement while offering ways to handle rigid repairs or fastening that I may need to undo."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Cutting wheels and sanding discs assume a grinder project that my purchases do not establish, so they do not feel useful right now.",
    "The battery lugs serve much heavier wiring than my small crimp connectors, while the washers and nuts require specific sizes I have no current need for.",
    "Super glue interests me as a repair adhesive, but ten tubes feel excessive without a specific use; fifty cutting wheels are similarly hard to justify."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repair supplies seem to have been taken as a broad interest in metalworking equipment, although I choose supplies for particular practical jobs.",
    "My past bulk purchases seem to have been treated as a preference for large quantities across different supplies, even when my likely need is occasional."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Compatibility matters: electrical supplies need to suit the wire sizes I use, and hardware needs to match an actual repair.",
    "I respond to a clear purpose, such as insulating a connection or making a removable fastening, more than to simply having additional workshop supplies."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognize my practical repair interests but stretch them too far into specialized equipment and quantities without a clear use."
}
